Located 15 seconds from Coquina Pool and just 2 minutes from the beach access, this pet-friendly cottage blends coastal charm with modern comforts. Perfect for relaxing in serene outdoor spaces, exploring with included beach bikes, or enjoying tranquil views from the lovely porch or balcony. With creamy neutral tones and calming blue and green accents, the main living area offers the perfect retreat after a day of sun and sand.
